summary: The response does well against every criterion. It refuses to run the runbook blindly and separates the node-left case from the partition case. It asks for cluster_status from all three nodes plus other read-only checks, and explains that a reset on the wrong node can discard queues still in use. It says the runbook applies only to the node-left case, with prerequisites, blast radius, a stop condition, verification and an approver. For a partition, it says to stop and escalate to the platform/control-plane owner. Its verification step includes checking that consumers have reconnected. It commits none of the critical errors, cites nothing from the book, and does not invent anything about the user's environment.
